summary: Full backend + frontend test of RDX Car Showroom (first iteration). 30/30 pytest backend tests pass. All frontend flows (login pre-fill + wrong-pw toast + successful login, dashboard 6 stats + 8 recent rows + view dialog, all 9 sidebar routes, vehicle records CRUD with search filter, all 3 reports formats (csv/xlsx/pdf) with actual browser downloads, analytics daily/weekly/monthly tabs rendering Recharts svgs, settings save with success toast, users add/delete, and logout->/login) work end-to-end. Fixed one HIGH-severity backend bug (POST /api/users returned 500 due to Mongo ObjectId leak in response body).

issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1) height(-1) should be greater than 0' during initial mount of trend sparklines. Cosmetic only – charts still render after layout settles. Consider adding minWidth/minHeight or aspect ratio to the ResponsiveContainer.
shadcn/Radix a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add a DialogDescription (can be visually hidden) for accessibility.
'© 2026 hyundai Car Showroom...' – 'hyundai' should be capitalised to match brand casing.

action_items: (Already fixed by testing agent) POST /api/users returned 500 because the inserted mongo _id (ObjectId) leaked into the FastAPI response spread. Fixed by excluding _id in the return dict.
(Optional polish) Give ResponsiveContainer a fixed height / aspect to remove Recharts width/height warnings on StatCard sparklines.
(Optional polish) Add DialogDescription to VehicleDetails and Vehicle form dialogs to remove Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/users – motor.insert_one mutates the passed dict (adds _id ObjectId); spreading it back into the response caused a 500. Now fixed by excluding _id.

server.py analytics_overview 'monthly' loop uses (now - timedelta(days=30*i)).replace(day=1) which drifts across long months (e.g. Feb) – not incorrect but can produce duplicate/missing months at year boundaries. Consider using dateutil.relativedelta.
server.py verify_password uses bcrypt.checkpw – hashes will start with $2b$ as required. Confirmed.
server.py sets cookies with secure=False – acceptable for the preview environment (http/https via ingress) but should be gated on ENV in production.
Dashboard.jsx StatCard sparkline containers do not set min height/width leading to Recharts warnings on first paint.
test_credentials: admin@rdx.com / admin123 (as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md, verified working)
seed_data_creation: Backend seeded 42 demo vehicles + admin + 3 demo users at startup as expected. Tests created and cleaned up TEST_-prefixed users and vehicles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression suite (pytest -n auto compatible). Login uses httpOnly cookies + bearer fallback. Reports export supports csv/xlsx/pdf across daily/weekly/monthly. Users list also includes 3 demo users (manager@rdx.com, security@rdx.com, security2@rdx.com) besides admin. Note: users POST endpoint previously leaked mongo _id – now fixed; ensure future patches don't regress by spreading mongo docs into responses.
rca of the issue: POST /api/users failed with 500 because motor's insert_one(doc) mutates the input document by injecting an ObjectId under key '_id'. The endpoint then did `**{k: v for k, v in doc.items() if k != 'password_hash'}` which included the ObjectId; FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId, resulting in TypeError. Fix: exclude both 'password_hash' and '_id' from the spread. Reproduction: POST /api/users with a fresh email. Mitigation applied in /app/backend/server.py.
